kinds.a: key padlock · combination padlock · shackle lock
kinds.d: A portable lock with a hinged or sliding shackle, secured by key or combination to a hasp, chain or cable.
A hinged strap and fixed eye screwed to door and frame, through which a padlock is passed.
m: Y155B High Security Hardened Steel Hasp

kinds.d: A hardened steel chain, usually sleeved, used with a padlock to secure gates, sheds, bikes or motorcycles.
A flexible steel cable, often plastic-coated, with built-in or padlock closure for securing loose items.

kinds.a: wall anchor · floor anchor · security anchor
kinds.d: A heavy fixing bolted or set into a floor or wall, to which items are chained and padlocked.

notes: Padlock: kept one kind with seven attribute types as briefed; cut 13 models to 8 across Abus, Squire, Master Lock, Yale and Ingersoll (dropped Abus Silver Rock 5, Squire ST50/Vulcan/Warrior, Yale Y222B as same-brand size/finish variants and SKU noise); kept the three ranges. Sold Secure Diamond winners not added because this is a no-research shelf. Hasp and staple: cut 16 to 6 (one standard and one high-security per brand), dropping the Abus 100/110/125/138-150/140 series duplicates and the Cisa and Crompton trade SKUs. Security chain: no models kept; types now encode Sold Secure grade and noose/straight form. Cable lock: no models; types encode closure and construction. Ground anchor: cut 6 to 4 (dropped Squire GA7 and WA500 as larger siblings of GA6/WA300); types encode fixing method. All old 's' values kept, including the empty padlock source.
